question: Does a new Chroma Cloud Starter account create a database and spend the USD 5 of credits with no payment method on file, and what happens when the credits are gone with no card?
why: The vendor's video description says the USD 5 needs no credit card, and the video says to add a credit card to keep using Chroma after the trial; the sign-up page offers only GitHub and Google sign-in; the pricing FAQ says a usage limit set by the customer or by Chroma pauses the service.
